# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.

completion:
For every monitoring result report the average of at least 5 data points taken in quick succession.
3. If there are more than 5 data points over the specified amount or at least 6 data points in a row and if all are above the specified amount:
  * start your sentence with the data point with the maximum.
  * for the second (and following) data points average in order of decreasing amount until you get below the specified limit.
  * add up the data points you averaged.
  * if you've exceeded your limit, just add the last data point to your total and use "and" to separate it from the rest of the items.
  * if you've remained within your limit add "then", to your sentence, and insert your averaged amount as the final event.
4. If any subsequent data reveals your readings have fallen below the limit, report the maximum amount from the set
